offering_description.value: Legence installs, upgrades and maintains building systems for owners, operators and general contractors. Its engineering teams design mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems and advise clients on energy efficiency. Its contracting teams fabricate assemblies off-site and install and service systems in the field.

primary_services.value: Building systems installation and retrofits; preventive maintenance and repair; mechanical, electrical and plumbing engineering; building commissioning; energy efficiency consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: General contractors, data center operators, commercial property owners, hospitals, universities and life sciences companies; B2G: Government facility owners, public school districts and public universities

end_markets.value: Data centers; commercial real estate; healthcare; education; life sciences

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Building systems design, installation, retrofits and recurring maintenance agreements; service fees: Repair calls, commissioning and energy consulting engagements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Designs systems to client specifications and integrates purchased equipment for building owners, operators and general contractors

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with operations across multiple regions

specialization.value: related lines: Mechanical, electrical and plumbing design, installation and maintenance, plus commissioning and energy efficiency consulting

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Regional engineering and contracting teams bid for work with building owners, operators and general contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Building systems design and installation are subject to state licensing, local building codes and OSHA rules

notes: The current scope of operations outside the United States is uncertain.
